text: Hi, where is my order? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
Your order is with the carrier and out for delivery today. Here is your tracking link.
My delivery keeps getting pushed back. When will it actually come?
Sorry for the wait. The carrier now shows delivery by Thursday. Here is the latest tracking update.
It says delivered, but I never got it.
I'm sorry. I've checked the carrier record: it shows delivered on Tuesday at 3:12 pm.
I want a refund for the blender I bought.
I can help with that. Here is our return policy and how to start a refund.
How do I return a jacket that doesn't fit?
You can start a free return within 30 days. Here is your return label.
Someone changed my password and placed an order I didn't make.
I'm sorry. This needs our security team, so I'm connecting you with a person now.
This is the third time my order arrived damaged. I'm really unhappy.
I'm sorry this keeps happening. I'm bringing in a member of our team who can sort this out.
